capabilities: Times focus sessions per note, canvas and Excalidraw drawing
Shows a zoomable treemap heatmap of all vault files
Colours files by last visit, modification, creation or type
Sizes rectangles by visit time or file size
Merges a single-linked note into the note that links to it
extras: History is stored as plain text in a hidden .plugin_data/visit_history/ folder, which Obsidian Sync skips, so each device keeps its own history. Journey visualization and nearby search are listed as roadmap items that are not built yet.
problem: Obsidian keeps no record of which notes you actually spend time in, so vault activity and neglected files stay invisible.
summary: Records focus time per note, canvas and Excalidraw drawing and renders the vault as a zoomable treemap heatmap.
